_label: S007 Phase 2 / G016. The 66-cycle behaviour treated as the patient. Names the FIRST boundary where autonomous engineering stops advancing, with the discriminator that established it and the rival hypotheses it beat -- including one that was REFUTED.
_evidence: MEASURED. Tool-menu claims verified by executing serve.py's own schema-construction call; behavioural claims verified by grepping all 66 raw evidence files; the fs.read defect verified by invoking the live tool registry; the prior-success precedent verified by reading the actual commit and its receipt.

THE_FIRST_BOUNDARY.verdict: The loop never crosses ORIENTATION -> HYPOTHESIS because on this execution path NOTHING EVER REQUIRES IT TO. The selfdev harness posts a flat chat turn to /v1/chat/completions, where a reply that contains no tool call and no mutation is a WELL-FORMED COMPLETION. The harness logs 'cycle N: reachable 11/11' and moves on. There is no state, no verdict and no failure mode anywhere in the path that distinguishes 'oriented usefully' from 'oriented for the sixty-sixth time'.
THE_FIRST_BOUNDARY.why_this_is_the_FIRST_boundary: everything downstream (discriminator, repo.edit, typed mutation, verification, landing) was independently confirmed REACHABLE and WORKING. The path does not break at the mutation machinery; it never arrives there. The stop is upstream of the first hypothesis.
THE_FIRST_BOUNDARY.the_structural_asymmetry: On the bounded path (Engine.execute + a compiled WorkerPacket) a reply that is not a mutation FAILS THE UNIT -- the transaction snapshots, applies, proves red-before-green, and rolls back or accepts, producing a machine verdict. On the chat path the same body producing the same prose scores a successful cycle. Same model, same weights, same tools: the difference that decides whether it acts is whether NOT ACTING IS ALLOWED TO SUCCEED.

REFUTED_HYPOTHESIS_recorded_deliberately.claim: repo.edit was never in the model's tool menu -- BUILDER_TOOLS is gated on an engine the harness never granted, so 66 cycles of zero edits were a capability gate, not a choice.
REFUTED_HYPOTHESIS_recorded_deliberately.why_it_was_plausible: chat_tools.py:819 does gate BUILDER_TOOLS on `write`, and serve.py:836 only builds stores['engine'] `if write` -- the gate is real and the reasoning was sound.
REFUTED_HYPOTHESIS_recorded_deliberately.how_it_was_REFUTED: two independent checks. (1) RUNTIME RECEIPT: serve.py:575 sets session.authority to 'write' iff stores.get('engine') is not None, and .hcli/chat/hcli-selfdev.json records authority='write' -- written by the serving process itself, so the engine WAS present. (2) DIRECT SIMULATION: executing serve.py:640-641's exact call, openai_schemas(registry, list(builder_menu(True))), emits 11 schemas and repo.edit is one of them, with full typed parameters.
REFUTED_HYPOTHESIS_recorded_deliberately.verdict: REFUTED. repo.edit was advertised to the body, with a schema, on every one of the 66 cycles. The door was open and unused.
REFUTED_HYPOTHESIS_recorded_deliberately.why_this_is_recorded: acting on it would have 'fixed' a non-existent gate, declared victory, and left the real boundary untouched -- while the fix itself (granting write authority that was already granted) would have looked like it worked because the tests would pass. A refuted hypothesis that nearly consumed the intervention is worth as much of the record as the confirmed one.

tool_calls_emitted_across_66_cycles.method: grep over all cycle-*.txt for the body's own call openers
tool_calls_emitted_across_66_cycles.note: 100% read-only. The single textual occurrence of 'repo.edit' anywhere in 66 cycles (cycle-0066) is the body ECHOING the objective's own prose back, not a call.

replies_truncated_before_a_DID_line.consequence: the harness seeds cycle N+1 with `last_summary`, scraped from the tail of cycle N. For three quarters of the run that tail is degenerate repetition cut mid-word (cycle 60 repeats one clause ~25x, drifting into 'uniquness'), so cross-cycle accumulation is largely noise -- the loop cannot compound what it never finished saying.

MAX_CALLS.consequence: an inspect->hypothesise->act arc must fit in 3 executed tool calls. The body spends all 3 reading, every cycle.

menu_shape.note: CHAT_TOOLS has 10 doors, BUILDER_TOOLS has exactly 1 (repo.edit). Not a gate, but a real 10:1 asymmetry in what the body is offered.

plan_churn.cause: hcli/chat_state.py asked_for_a_plan() substring-matches 'plan' (satisfied by the harness prompt's own word 'planned') plus a trigger verb, so the STANDING prompt re-triggers plan creation every cycle; asked_to_apply() never matches 'Do that next bounded action now'. Every cycle sees a fresh draft plan, never one with execution momentum.

prior_loop_that_DID_act.subject: feat(gravity): down_proj scale overhead, written by the resident and accepted
prior_loop_that_DID_act.path_used: bounded WorkUnit -> WorkerPacket -> Engine.execute, inside the mutation transaction with red_before_green and rollback
prior_loop_that_DID_act.note: the SAME resident wrote a function AND its test and had the change accepted. This is the control that makes the diagnosis a comparison rather than a story: the body is capable of the arc; the chat path is where the arc stops being required.
prior_loop_that_DID_act.caveat_from_its_own_receipt: the supervisor supplied that unit's goal and required return value, so it does not discharge S007's G004 bar -- but it does prove the bounded path reaches mutation.

SECOND_DEFECT_FOUND_not_on_any_hypothesi.name: fs.read reports an out-of-range window as a successful, complete, untruncated read

observed_behaviour_before_fix.call: fs.read(hcli/mutation.py, start_line=1620, end_line=1720) on a 247-line file

SECOND_DEFECT_FOUND_not_on_any_hypothesi.why_it_matters: failure returned SUCCESS. Nothing in the payload said the window does not exist, so a false belief about where a symbol lives could never be corrected by evidence. Cycle 47 shows the body emitting a runaway stream of fs.read calls walking a 247-line file toward line 1720 until the generation died; cycles 52-66 (fifteen consecutive) are consumed by one file the body believed it had never finished reading. The reported coordinates were themselves incoherent (end_line 247 BEFORE start_line 1620).
SECOND_DEFECT_FOUND_not_on_any_hypothesi.this_is_a_general_seam: it is not a defect handed to HCLI and not specific to any task -- it is a tool lying to whoever calls it, which is precisely the 'HCLI cannot observe reality needed to continue' intervention trigger. Fixed under G017.
SECOND_DEFECT_FOUND_not_on_any_hypothesi.irony_worth_recording: the neighbouring helper _truncation_fields exists BECAUSE of this same disease in a different branch -- its docstring records a model reasoning over 1.3% of a file without learning the rest existed. The empty-window branch was never given the same treatment.

HYPOTHESES_TESTED.h: objective too broad, continuously rewards orientation
HYPOTHESES_TESTED.evidence: objective.md asks for the whole arc in one open prompt; no sub-goal is ever closed, so every cycle legitimately restarts at 'inspect current body'.
there are NO WorkUnits on this path at all -- the harness bypasses the WorkUnit/packet machinery entirely and posts a flat chat string.

HYPOTHESES_TESTED.h: cycle prompt does not force transition from READ to TEST
HYPOTHESES_TESTED.evidence: every one of the 15 cycles that produced a NEXT: line begins it with 'I will read'. Not one names a test, a command, pytest, or a shell invocation, in 66 cycles.

HYPOTHESES_TESTED.h: persistent session state reinforces exploration instead of committing
HYPOTHESES_TESTED.evidence: 65 plans / 70 turns, none reaching status:executing (see plan_churn above).

HYPOTHESES_TESTED.h: tool schema/menu makes reading disproportionately attractive
HYPOTHESES_TESTED.evidence: 10 read doors vs 1 write door is a real asymmetry, but repo.edit WAS offered with a full schema every cycle -- so this shapes the gradient, it does not close the door.

HYPOTHESES_TESTED.h: model never receives an explicit action frontier
HYPOTHESES_TESTED.evidence: state.json carries next_action as free text scraped by regex from the reply's tail; it is never validated, never typed, and for 74% of cycles is scraped from truncated output.

HYPOTHESES_TESTED.evidence: MAX_CALLS=3 and the body spends all three reading; a read->locate->edit arc has no budget left even when it wants one.

HYPOTHESES_TESTED.evidence: 49/66 replies never reach a DID: line; the failure shape is repetition collapse (cycle 60) or a runaway read stream (cycle 47), both terminating mid-token.

HYPOTHESES_TESTED.h: repository map / Manifesto material dominates working context
HYPOTHESES_TESTED.evidence: working_set() was measured at ~471 chars earlier in the campaign -- small. No evidence the durable block crowds the window.

HYPOTHESES_TESTED.h: planner lacks an ORIENTED -> HYPOTHESIS_REQUIRED transition
HYPOTHESES_TESTED.evidence: state.json has a `phase` field that only ever holds 'developing' (and 'yielded' at shutdown). There is no phase machine; nothing can advance.

HYPOTHESES_TESTED.h: evidence from one cycle not distilled strongly enough into the next
HYPOTHESES_TESTED.evidence: last_summary is the last 4 lines of a reply that was truncated 74% of the time.

HYPOTHESES_TESTED.h: landing/mutation path technically available but not cognitively reachable
HYPOTHESES_TESTED.evidence: repo.edit advertised with a schema every cycle (refutation above), capability chain test-verified 25/25, and called zero times.

HYPOTHESES_TESTED.h: the resident needs a bounded experiment rather than an open-ended prompt
HYPOTHESES_TESTED.evidence: commit 390842354 -- the same body, on the bounded path, wrote a function and a test and had them accepted.

WHAT_THE_REPAIR_MUST_DO: Make not-acting FAIL rather than pass. The single highest-leverage change is that a cycle which produces no hypothesis, no discriminator and no mutation must be recorded as a failed cycle that changes the next prompt -- not as 'reachable 11/11, cycle complete'.
Give the loop a phase that advances and constrains: ORIENT -> HYPOTHESIS_REQUIRED -> DISCRIMINATE -> ACT -> VERIFY, persisted in the `phase` field that already exists and is currently inert.
Carry the selected hypothesis into the next model call intact, instead of a regex-scraped tail of a truncated reply.
Stop tools from lying about reality (fs.read out-of-range) so a false belief can be corrected by evidence rather than surviving fifteen cycles.
PROHIBITED throughout, per S007: no hardcoded defect for HCLI, no fabricated RED, no auto-created edit, no new autonomy framework. The repair changes HOW the loop runs, never WHAT it must fix.
